name: slate38
title: the slate
blurb: buildthis's official campaign site for bsky38.com's "38 most influential Bluesky posters of 2026" vote — a click-farming rolling-stone-style countdown slideshow of all 38. buildthis keeps the #1 slot for itself (per @antiali.as, back on the record wanting that), and @heika.dog talked their way into a guaranteed top-5 finish in the same thread; the other 36 get their real feed pulled and actually read live in-browser — a real highlight, a real low point, not just stats — into a hype pitch and a Hype Index score that decides their rank. Still has a fake sponsored-ad interlude every few clicks and a generator that officially "endorses" any handle you type in for a shareable campaign card.
